headline: Reliance misses earnings estimates as refining margins decline sharply
summary: Weak refining spreads and rising input costs drove losses in the O2C segment. Analysts cautious with downgrade to sell.

headline: Rising debt and weak demand threaten Reliance growth outlook
summary: Uncertainty in global demand outlook risk pressure on margins. Management warned of volatile operating environment and weak consumer sentiment.

headline: Reliance stock fell after downgrade on overvalued valuation concerns
summary: Bearish sentiment from institutional investors after multiple downgrades. Caution advised as downside risks to earnings increased.

headline: Reliance Retail slowdown and losses signal concern for segment outlook
summary: Revenue decline in retail division and weak footfall data worried analysts. Restructuring costs added further pressure to margins.

headline: Regulatory threat and competition risks rising for Reliance Jio
summary: Uncertain regulatory environment and competition pressure risk subscriber losses. Pessimistic outlook from sector analysts following slowing growth.
